reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 8 --verse 1.62.3: the evidence is verbatim in the ākhyāna opening Sāyaṇa’s comment on 1.62.3 (Saramā the devaśunī; cows carried off by the Paṇis; Indra sends her to search; she will go only if her young (śiśave) is given the milk-food of those cows, kṣīrādyannam; he agrees). The paraphrase, gods’ hound, cows the Paṇis stole, going only once Indra promised their milk to her young, is carried by his words in his order; Wilson note b agrees. The only change in this revision is the context clause: day.js 1.62.2 has Indra ‘through whom our sires, Angirases … found the cattle’, so ‘by whom the Angirases found the cattle’ is the text’s own; no four words of the key. Tried plain on ‘the search’ (not Griffith’s word; the passage is the finding of hidden cattle, and ‘knowing well the places’ carries it): does not land. Locator: 1.62 is not among the hymns where Sāyaṇa’s count differs. verse.js ok (Rig Veda 1.62.3, at [61,3], 13 words); entry-check ok. Yāska does not treat the verse.
